messages:
maya: Quick check — planning to bump api-service from v2.2 -> v2.3 this Thursday. Need to lock regional deploy cutoffs for US/EU/APAC and decide canary windows. Thinking: US first (12:00-14:00 UTC), EU second (16:00-18:00 UTC), APAC late-night (01:00-03:00 UTC next day). Any objections?

oliver: That order makes sense to me. Two asks: 1) make the EU slot 15:30-17:30 UTC to avoid payroll batch in eu-west at 17:00, 2) can we keep a 30m warmup before canary to pre-warm caches?

sophia: +1 on warmup. Also we should pin the DB migration to the EU window only — don't want cross-region schema drift. If migration planned, freeze client-facing rollouts until migration completes.

liam: FYI APAC has sustained traffic spikes at 02:00 UTC on Thursdays (backup jobs). If we land APAC at 01:00-03:00 that might overlap. Recommend shifting APAC window earlier by 1h (00:00-02:00 UTC) or later by 2h.

maya: Good catch, liam. Do we prefer earlier or later? We need to keep APAC outside business hours in region but avoid the backup window.

oliver: Earlier (00:00-02:00) seems fine for our infra team. On rollback: suggest we keep a 45m hold after each canary to validate metrics, and have an automated fallback to v2.2 if error rate > 1.5% or latency +30% baseline.

maya: Sounds good. Proposed final schedule (UTC):
```
US:   12:00 - 14:00 (canary at 12:15, hold until 13:00)
EU:   15:30 - 17:30 (migration window 15:30-16:00, canary at 16:15)
APAC: 00:00 - 02:00 (canary at 00:15, hold until 01:00)
```
Rules: DB migration only during EU window, 45m post-canary hold, automatic rollback triggers, feature flag gates for heavy paths.

deploy-bot: Deployment checklist created: https://deploys.redwood.local/checklists/1884218765 (owned by @oliver). Canary monitors: latency_p50, latency_p95, error_rate, tail_cpu. Auto-rollback enabled with threshold: error_rate > 1.5% OR latency_p95 > baseline * 1.30.

liam: Can you add a quick step to drain long-lived websocket sessions before handover? We saw stale sessions cause 502 cascades last month.

oliver: Good point — adding pre-drain 20m step into checklist. Also adding a note to set batching to conservative for first 2h in each region.

maya: Anyone opposed to a hard cutoff for merges into release/* branches 8 hours before regional start? Means: no merges to release branch after 04:00 UTC for US deploy at 12:00. Keeps last-minute surprises out.

liam: +1. Also request: tag all PRs touching runtime or db schema with "release-impact" so SRE can triage quickly.

sophia: I'll own verifying migration runbooks and coordinate with DB eng. Will post a short runbook link in this thread before EOD.

maya: Great — action items:
- oliver: own deploy checklist + pre-drain step (done)
- sophia: migration runbook + verify locks
- liam: confirm APAC traffic spike mitigation and approve 00:00-02:00 slot
- maya: publish final schedule to #eng-release-calendar and nudge product for changelog blurb

oliver: checklist link updated. Also pinging @deploy-bot to schedule a dry-run canary tomorrow at 12:15 UTC to sanity-check alerts.

deploy-bot: Dry-run scheduled for 1884305165 (tomorrow 12:15 UTC). No actual traffic will be routed; alerting pipeline exercised.

liam: APAC slot approved from infra side. I'll disable heavy backup job for that Thursday 02:00 UTC window.

sophia: Runbook draft: https://confluence.redwood.local/runbooks/api-v2.3-migration — I'll iterate and mention DB owner contacts.

maya: Perfect. I'll set merge cutoff to 04:00 UTC (8h before US start) and publish the calendar event now. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

oliver: Quick FYI — changelog blurb needs a note about client SDK bump and migration impact. I'll write it and drop in #product for review.

maya: Thread locked for now. If any blocker appears, reply here or DM.
